response.original_title: 吉沢明歩のＳＥＸ一本勝負　いっぱい突いて！
response.overview: Takeko, who devoted her days to Kendo at the dojo, was a beautiful swordswoman who cross-dressed as a man, wearing nothing but a *fundoshi* loincloth beneath her robes. Suzunosuke, her childhood friend and fellow student at the dojo, harbored a secret worry he could not share with her. Upon learning of his anguish, Takeko cast aside her training gear and embraced her identity as a woman.
response.title: 吉沢明歩のＳＥＸ一本勝負　いっぱい突いて！
